craft_notes: Sthāyin: compassion-gated teaching. Rows: request, permission, exclusion. Rejected: opening secrets — killed: marma excluded. Read aloud: open hand, closed fist.

lines: Pray the all-lore master to forth-tell — he, to his own or another's, shall tell the fitting lore in fitting measure;
even the low-creed listener, for pity, his heart quickened by hope of power's fall at the Lord's wayward will — tell him, save the whispered core.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sarvaśāstrasampūrṇaṃ guruṃ vyākhyārtham abhyarthayeta so 'pi svaśiṣyāya paraśiṣyāyāpi vā samucitasaṃskārocitaṃ śāstraṃ vyācakṣīta adharaśāsanasthāyāpi karuṇāvaśāt īśvarecchāvaicitryodbhāvitaśaktipātasambhāvanābhāvitahṛdayo vyācakṣīta marmopadeśavarjam
